exposure: Maternal immigration status (native Portuguese vs. migrant)
outcome: Risk factors for adverse pregnancy outcomes
cohort: Mothers and infants from the Generation XXI birth cohort
finding: Migrant mothers had a lower risk of low birthweight and small for gestational age compared to native Portuguese mothers, while the risk for preterm birth was similar between groups.
mod_finding: Prevalence of caesarean section was higher among migrant mothers (45.7%) compared to native Portuguese mothers (35.2%).
